base_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square thumbnail for an open-source Factorio multiplayer scenario mod portal
Primary request: Create a distinctive compact emblem communicating separate multiplayer teams, isolated safe spawns, factory planning, and interplanetary expansion.
Scene/backdrop: dark charcoal square backdrop with a subtle circular planet silhouette.
Subject: four small industrial outposts arranged around the planet, each with its own colored safe-zone ring, linked visually by restrained conveyor-belt geometry and one clean power-grid motif without implying the electrical networks are shared.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted game-mod icon, crisp geometric silhouettes, slightly isometric, readable at 144x144, original visual identity.
Composition/framing: centered symmetric emblem, generous edge padding, strong hierarchy, no tiny details.
Lighting/mood: energetic but trustworthy, high contrast.
Color palette: graphite, iron gray, warm copper, electric cyan, muted lime and amber team accents.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no copyrighted game characters or official Factorio logo, no photorealism, no UI screenshot, no weapons dominating the image.
edit_prompt: Edit the generated square mod thumbnail while preserving its four colored industrial outposts, dark planet, polished isometric style, palette, symmetry, lighting, and text-free composition. Change only the connectivity metaphor: remove every conveyor, cable, pipe, and copper line that connects an outpost to the center or to another outpost. Leave clear dark-space gaps between all four colored safe zones. Give each outpost one small self-contained pole/grid detail entirely inside its own colored ring. Replace the center with a simple subtle four-way compass/spawn marker that does not touch any base. Keep it crisp and readable at 144x144. No text, logo, watermark, characters, or official game branding.
ai_assistance_icon_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square technology icon for an open-source Factorio multiplayer mod
Primary request: Create an original compact icon for an early-game technology called AI Assistance, communicating a powered factory intelligence uplink that advises a human engineer.
Subject: a small copper-and-iron radio uplink terminal with a glowing cyan circuit-brain core, one simple antenna arc, and a subtle red automation-science flask motif integrated behind it.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted industrial strategy-game technology icon, crisp chunky silhouette, slightly isometric, readable at 64x64 and 128x128, original visual identity.
Composition/framing: centered single emblem, generous edge padding, no tiny wires, strong circular or diamond silhouette.
Lighting/mood: inventive, approachable, trustworthy; warm copper rim light and cool cyan core.
Color palette: iron gray, oxidized copper, electric cyan, restrained red accent, dark navy backdrop.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no copyrighted game characters, no official Factorio logo, no photorealism, no UI screenshot, no humanoid robot, no generic sparkle effects. Square 1:1.
ai_assistance_icon_edit_prompt: Edit the supplied square AI Assistance technology icon. Preserve the exact overall composition, centered copper-and-iron radio uplink terminal, antenna arcs, chunky readable silhouette, dark navy background, copper rim, subtle red automation-science flask/circuit motif, lighting, and generous padding. Change the terminal display only: replace the generic cyan circuit-brain glyph with a clearly recognizable, friendly Claude AI mascot/brand mark rendered as the characteristic warm terracotta-orange radiating starburst/asterisk character, clean and simple enough to read at 64x64. Give it a subtle cyan screen glow so it belongs in the existing device, but keep the mascot itself warm Claude orange. It should feel approachable and unmistakably AI-assisted, not like a human face or humanoid robot. No text, letters, watermark, official Factorio logo, UI screenshot, extra objects, or composition changes. Square 1:1.
ai_assistance_icon_background_extraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Factorio technology icon source
Primary request: Isolate the complete copper-and-iron AI uplink device and its circular mechanical halo from the supplied image, preserving the exact subject design, front-facing composition, Claude-inspired orange starburst, cyan radio arcs, copper rim, dark metal details, and crisp Factorio-style painted rendering. Replace only the dark navy square background with a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later removal.
Composition: centered square icon, preserve the existing subject scale and generous but minimal padding; keep every outer copper halo tab and the bottom base fully inside the canvas.
Constraints: background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, vignette, glow spill, or lighting variation. No cast shadow or contact shadow outside the subject. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject. No text, watermark, border, or square backing plate. Change only the background; keep the device and halo visually faithful.
